headline: Sao Paulo Legislature Fast-Tracks Bill Changing Teacher Career Rules
summary: A bill altering teacher career rules in Sao Paulo was included on the legislative agenda under an urgency regime for immediate voting.
why: State-level public sector labor and career reform bills affect state budget expenditures and public employee relations.
